o.text: From Arabic فَلْسَفَة (falsafa), from Ancient Greek φιλοσοφία (philosophía).
Internationalism; likely via Russian дезинфекция (dezinfekcija), from French désinfection.
Borrowed from Classical Persian آتشپرست (ātaš-parast). By surface analysis, atəş + -pərəst.
